title: decision: identifierQuery answers HTTP 200 for every decodable request
description: protocol-06 §5.8 gives the outcome as IdentifierResponse.responseCode (success, notFound, ambiguous, forbidden, unsupportedField) and names no HTTP status. mimid answers 200 with an IdentifierResponse body for every decodable request whatever the code, and 400 only for an undecodable body, missing/malformed From, or a path domain that is not this provider (as .7.37). Contrast: Haven answers 404 with no body for not-found (its DIV-4).
